slice: R.242 Dashboard Material Summary Single-Connection Read
phase: Phase 3 Admin Read Model and Query API performance
full_goal_statement: This advances Admin Architecture v1 by reducing Dashboard material-summary read-model overhead. It does not complete material-summary projection rebuilds, Protection Gate coverage, route-loader restructuring, UI information architecture, redundancy cleanup, Docker release gates, or the full Admin Architecture v1 goal.

role_review.project_architect: approved: the slice stays on the read-model/query mainline and does not convert the issue into a Dashboard UI patch.
role_review.delivery_lead: approved: the change is GET/read-path only, preserves response shape and freshness behavior, and does not write or rebuild NAS data.

summary: readAdminDashboardMaterialSummaryFromStore now opens admin.sqlite once and reuses metadata/counts for freshness.
The function no longer calls readAdminReadModelStoreStatus and then reopens the same store for material metadata.
The read path still refuses missing stores, stale stores, missing material-summary metadata, and summary count mismatches.
A direct NAS inspection showed the current store has no dashboard_material_* metadata rows, so projection availability remains a separate follow-up.
non_goals: No broad cache or fixture substitution.

data_findings: The live NAS admin.sqlite currently has no dashboard_material_* metadata rows.
The optimized reader returns null faster when material-summary metadata is absent.
A later projection/rebuild slice should decide how and when dashboard_material_* metadata is created without mutating data from page requests.

verification.redundancy_audit_note: The audit command exited successfully and preserved the governance state: cleanup remains blocked until candidates are reviewed. This is expected because R.242 is not a redundancy-cleanup slice.

remaining_gaps: Dashboard material-summary projection availability is still unresolved because the observed admin.sqlite has no dashboard_material_* metadata rows.
Dashboard production_summary remains variable and measured 190ms in the latest cold sample.
usage_metrics still costs about 112ms on the observed NAS run.
Source-video status_store_page remains the dominant source-video status-list cost.
Route-loader restructuring, UI information architecture, Protection Gate completion, redundancy cleanup, Docker release gates, and full Admin Architecture v1 remain incomplete.
